name: Melio
summary: Bill payments for small businesses by bank transfer or card, syncing with your accounting tools. Card payments carry a flat 2.9%, which only pays off when you are deliberately floating cash.
best_for: small businesses that want to pay bills by bank transfer or card and get paid, starting free with no subscription
skip_if: you already run AP through robust accounting software with bill-pay built in — a second tool adds little
honest_knock: The free plan is genuinely useful for low bill volume, but the value case narrows as you scale into paid tiers — and the 2.9% card fee only makes sense when you're deliberately floating cash on a card for rewards or timing.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-07 on their own pricing page) A free Go plan, $0 forever, with 5 free ACH payments a month and $0.50 for each one after that. Core is $25/mo, or $20 billed annually, with 20 free ACH a month; Boost $55/mo, or $44 annually, with 50 free ACH; Unlimited $80/mo, or $64 annually, with unlimited users. Go is limited to one user. The detail our earlier note missed: every paid plan adds $10 a month per additional user, or $8 on annual billing, so a three-person finance team on Core is $45 a month rather than $25. Card payments carry a flat 2.9% fee; a standard paper check is $1.50 and a wire $10 per payment, with faster options priced higher. Paid plans now start with 90 days free rather than the 30 days we noted earlier: the page offers 90 days of unlimited free ACH payments with no card, and an account that has not subscribed by then drops to Go, losing premium features and the data held in them.
